thread:
harry: Heads-up: theres a mystery pot labeled "office chili" in the fridge with no heat level. Mild or volcanic? Also the espresso machine showed E02 this morning.
nina: If its above medium Im surrendering my lunch. Also espresso fix: press+hold white button for 3s to clear error (worked for me yesterday).
zane: Small plea: please label Tupperware (name + date). Found lasagna from February.
ada: (typo) ada: I can bring sticky labels and make spice stickers: Mild / Medium / Nuclear. And I'll bring oat milk tomorrow.
kitchen-bot: Inventory alert: whole-bean coffee low; sugar jar at 10% capacity. Suggested action: restock within 48h. react :bell:
security-bot: Reminder: Do not prop kitchen door after 7pm. Building policy.
harry: Thinking: micro "snack-stash" fund ($1/week) so someone buys basics. Volunteers to manage jar?
nina: Love the fund idea. Also secret cookie stash is sacred  please leave a note if you take one.
zane: I'll make a small bin labeled "Orphan lids" and put it on the top shelf. Too many containers, no lids.
ada: ada: Quick shoutout to whoever swapped the coffee filter last night  thank you, coffee hero.
harry: I'll pick up filters and a mini labeler after standup. Also putting spice stickers on the chili. Cookie meeting at 4pm? :cookie:
kitchen-bot: Action logged: Restock request submitted for sugar and whole-bean coffee. react :white_check_mark:
security-bot: FYI CCTV covers entryways not the fridge interior; please dont leave wallets or laptops unattended.
nina: Perfect. Also could we add a tiny sign on the microwave: "No tin foil" and "Cover your plate"? saves everyone.
zane: Ill make the microwave sign and tape it tonight.
ada: ada: Thanks all! Cookie meeting at 4, chili will be labeled. No nuclear variants without a warning label. :laughing:
